summary: Master the ADDIE model, SAM framework, and Kirkpatrick evaluation in our 5-day Instructional Design Fundamentals Training. Build high-impact corporate programs.
lede: Instructional design is a structured way to turn learning needs into planned learning experiences and materials. This course is for learning and development professionals, instructional designers, curriculum developers, and eLearning content developers who need to address performance gaps. It covers needs analysis, learning objectives, content planning, storyboarding, assessment design, and evaluation of training outcomes.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the design, development, and delivery of corporate education who need to move beyond intuitive teaching to evidence-based instructional architecture.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 1-2 years of experience in a training, teaching, or human resources role. A basic understanding of corporate organizational structures is required. No prior experience with specific eLearning authoring tools is necessary, though familiarity with standard office productivity software is expected.
